query:
UPDATE employees e
INNER JOIN users u ON e.userId = u.id
SET e.gender = CASE 
  WHEN u.sexo = 'Masculino' THEN 'male'
  WHEN u.sexo = 'Femenino' THEN 'female'
  ELSE 'prefer_not_to_say'
END
WHERE e.userId IS NOT NULL AND u.sexo IS NOT NULL;
